notes: Primary analysis model per OSF v4. 4B parameters, 36 transformer layers, 2560 hidden dim, Apache-2.0. NOTE (2026-05-30 [BUGFIX]): hidden dim is 2560, NOT 3584 — it does NOT match Qwen2.5-7B (3584). The earlier claim that the shared 3584 dim enabled an H5 silhouette comparison was based on a wrong architecture constant; silhouette is computed within each model's own space and does not require matching hidden dims, so H5 is unaffected, but any cross-model reasoning that assumed dimensional parity must be re-checked. No public SAEs available, so H3 is delegated to the two Gemma models.
